notes.title: HOTFIX!
notes.content: [p][b]We've just released a hotfix for [i]No Customers Left[/i] addressing the majority of bugs reported since launch. We sincerely apologize to anyone who encountered issues during their experience — your feedback has been invaluable, and we truly appreciate your support. [/b][/p][p][b]Please continue to report any bugs you find so we can keep improving the game. [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Thank you for playing and sticking with us![/i][/b][/p]
